title: Scientist X lecture at University of Denver

tellings.quote: On March 8th, 1950, Newton took the stage as [music] the mysterious scientist X.

plain: On March 8, 1950, a man named Silas Newton gave a talk at the University of Denver as a mysterious, unnamed "Scientist X." Michels tells it himself in an episode about a claimed crash in which 16 alien bodies were recovered. He presents the lecture as an early public telling of that crash story, given by a man hiding his own name.
